name: 46321 · Munster, IN
findings: ZIP 46321 (Munster) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46321 (Munster) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46321 (Munster) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
